title: Keep Acceptance and WMBT headers out of journey specs

facts.note: Browser specs run by Playwright, identified by file name.

Any non-bun (Playwright) test file can be a browser spec if its header comments carry a journey marker or it is bound to a train/journey. Bun test files are excluded unconditionally, even if they carry journey markers; needs a runner classifier (Playwright vs bun test).

Needs a header-comment scanner (htmx_e2e_detector) that reads leading `// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`, `// Acceptance:` and `// WMBT:` lines, not string literals.
Fires when a journey spec is written or edited.

fires: A `*.e2e.ts` Playwright spec has a `// Acceptance:` header line.
A Playwright test file not named `*.e2e.*` whose header carries `// Journey:` or `// URN: test:train:…` also carries `// WMBT:`.
An agent adds `// Acceptance:`/`// WMBT:` lines to an existing journey spec to link it to an acceptance.
doesNotFire: A bun test file carrying `// Acceptance:` and `// WMBT:` headers, with or without a journey marker — a bun test file is never a journey spec.
A bun test file whose header carries `// Journey:` (or `// URN: test:journey:…`) together with `// Acceptance:`/`// WMBT:` lines.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN inside a string literal.

given: A journey spec: a browser spec that is not a bun test file — a `*.e2e.*` file run by Playwright, or a Playwright/test file bound to a train or journey via header comments (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`). Bun test files are never journey specs.
when: the spec is written or edited
then: The journey spec MUST NOT carry `// Acceptance:` or `// WMBT:` header lines.
prefer: Move acceptance assertions out of the journey spec into an acceptance test that declares the Acceptance/WMBT pair.
Or simply drop the `// Acceptance:`/`// WMBT:` lines and keep the spec bound only to its train or journey.
avoid: Giving one test both a journey identity (train/journey) and an acceptance identity (Acceptance/WMBT).
Renaming a journey spec away from `*.e2e.*` to escape the check while it keeps a journey marker — misnamed specs are still judged.
Treating a bun test file as a journey spec.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: Journey and acceptance identities are exclusive: a journey test binds to a train or journey, an acceptance test to an Acceptance/WMBT pair. Carrying both makes the test ambiguous about what it proves.
evidence: The htmx_e2e_detector reports no browser spec whose header comments contain `// Acceptance:` or `// WMBT:` lines.
Either fix is valid: the Acceptance/WMBT lines were dropped from the journey spec, or — if acceptance assertions were moved — they appear in an acceptance test carrying the Acceptance/WMBT pair.
verifier_detail: browser_spec = a `*.e2e.ts` (`*.e2e.*`) file run by Playwright, or any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`), so a misnamed one is still judged.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string is not a browser spec — match header comment lines only, not string literals.
A bun test file is never a journey spec — exclude bun test files unconditionally, even if they carry journey markers.
Forbidden header lines in a journey spec: `// Acceptance:` and `// WMBT:`.
Validator implementation: htmx_e2e_detector. Severity 3, disposition strict (see policy.strict-disposition).
audit: Source name/summary: 'A journey spec carries no Acceptance or WMBT header.'
